SHP-2412.subject: Shipment SHP-2412: revised delivery time 13:30
SHP-2412.body:
Dear Mr. Victor Hale,

We are writing to let you know that shipment SHP-2412 has been delayed by a major traffic incident. To limit the impact we have taken the following step: rebook DC-Omaha dock for 13:30. The revised arrival time is 13:30, which is 36 minutes after your agreed window closing at 12:54. We apologise for the inconvenience and will confirm on arrival.

Kind regards,
Operations Desk, Tallgrass Logistics
